messages:
Meera Shah: Quick update for everyone — were standing up a small, focused Embedded Customer Success Engineering (Embedded CSE) stream to handle deep integrations with Dedicated and Private customers. Anya Patel is joining as Director of Embedded CSE and starts on Mon May 12. Welcome Anya! :tada:

Meera Shah: What changes: Embedded CSE will be carved out from CS-Platform. Embedded CSE will own customer-side deployments, integration playbooks, and the on-call rotation for private deployments. Platform-facing CS work (core observability, shared integrations) stays with Lizzys team. This is a reorg using existing headcount: were reallocating two open CS Ops IC reqs + one contractor slot. No new headcount this quarter.

Anya Patel: Thrilled to join — excited to dig in. First order of business: Ill post a 60/90 day priorities doc by Thu and schedule weekly syncs with Lizzy and platform leads.

Lizzy Mendoza: Congrats Anya! Quick ask: please route any platform-change requests to me as the primary escalation (cc Anya). I also propose a standing 30m weekly triage between Embedded CSE, Platform Eng, and Runtime to handle cross-customer infra work.

Evan Carter: Congrats! For interviewing, recommend adding 1 architecture deep-dive + 1 runtime question to the loop. I can own crafting the loop if folks OK. Also we should test for private-deploy troubleshooting experience.

Meera Shah: Hiring priorities for Q2 (reallocated):
- 2x Senior Embedded CSE (customer integrations, orchestration + infra troubleshooting)
- 1x Staff SWE (automation & integration tooling)
- 1x TPM (customer rollouts)
Recruiting: please create reqs today and attach the interview rubric.

Recruiting Bot: Created reqs: REQ-4901 (Sr Embedded CSE), REQ-4902 (Sr Embedded CSE), REQ-4903 (Staff SWE), REQ-4904 (TPM). Owners: Anya (REQ-4901/4902/4904), Lizzy (REQ-4903). Panel owner: Evan Carter. Interview kit attached.

Ash Sinha: From compensation/ops: because these roles include on-call and occasional customer travel, comp bands may need ~5-8% uplift vs general CS bands. People-ops will fast-track approvals since these are internal reallocations; expect guidance by EOD Friday. Please ensure scorecard checklists are completed before phone screens.

Meera Shah: Action items recap:
1) Recruiting: post JD + attach loop and rubric (today)
2) Anya: 60/90 day plan + weekly sync invite (this week)
3) Evan/Lizzy/Anya: finalize interview panel & loop by Thu EOD
4) People-ops (Ash): run comp guidance and sign approvals (by Fri)
5) All: drop candidate source tips / referrals into the hiring doc (link below)
Link: <https://intranet.redwood/hiring/embedded-cse-launch>

Anya Patel: Thanks all. Ill reach out for 1:1 intros and will schedule a short "what success looks like" session for the broader CS/Platform audience next week.

Lizzy Mendoza: Happy to pair on the first two candidates. Also Ill add the observability onboarding checklist to the doc.

Evan Carter: Loop draft coming tomorrow AM. Will include a runbook troubleshooting scenario.

Recruiting Bot: Candidate referral form updated: <https://intranet.redwood/referrals>. Notifying hiring owners.

Meera Shah: Thanks everyone  keeping thread for updates — well send a cross-org announcement after the initial hires are onboarded. :sparkles:
